text: A股半导体板块短线拉升，托伦斯涨超17%，大为股份涨超8%，北方华创、杰华特、富满微、源杰科技、臻宝科技、格科微等个股跟涨。消息面上，台积电据悉计划从2027年起上调先进及成熟制程价格，基础涨幅最高达10%。同时，源杰科技公告，预计上半年净利润6.00亿元-6.50亿元，同比增长1197%-1305%。
text_en: A-share semiconductor sector rallied, Torrence up over 17%, Dawei Shares up over 8%, NAURA Technology, Joulwatt, Fuman Micro, Yuanjie Technology, Zhenbao Technology, Goke Micro and others followed. News: TSMC reportedly plans to raise prices for advanced and mature process nodes from 2027, with base increases up to 10%. Meanwhile, Yuanjie Technology announced expected H1 net profit of RMB 600-650 million, up 1197%-1305% YoY.
